| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Vertical vector** `vertical` | E5 edge | L5 level, E5 edge, S5 spot, W5 wave, R5 ripple | The vector down the columns of the mask. |
| **Horizontal vector** `horizontal` | L5 level | L5 level, E5 edge, S5 spot, W5 wave, R5 ripple | The vector along the rows of the mask. |
| **Energy window** `window` | 15 | 3 to 31, odd px | The window for the energy average and for the mean removal. Laws used 15. |
| **Remove local mean** `removeMean` | on | On or off | Subtract the local mean before the mask, so the brightness does not count. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
